ASTRA Biological Organisation — Research Continuation

1. A stronger principle: cells can respond to the future usefulness of molecules

The previous model treated tissue organisation as a problem of where to place specialised cells. I have extended it to a sequence of chemical operations:

S→Role AI→Role BP.S\xrightarrow{\text{Role A}}I \xrightarrow{\text{Role B}}P.SRole A​IRole B​P.

Here SSS is a substrate, III an intermediate and PPP the useful final product. Different cells perform different stages of the process.

The key insight is to distinguish a molecule's present concentration from its probability of eventually contributing to the desired function.

Let VS,VI,VPV_S,V_I,V_PVS​,VI​,VP​ denote these future-value probabilities at every position. Under linear transport, one-to-one conversion, degradation and collection, they solve reverse transport equations. For example,

APTVP=c,AITVI=kB(1−a)VP,ASTVS=kAaVI.A_P^T V_P=c,\qquad A_I^T V_I=k_B(1-a)V_P,\qquad A_S^T V_S=k_AaV_I.APT​VP​=c,AIT​VI​=kB​(1−a)VP​,AST​VS​=kA​aVI​.

The local advantage of changing a cell from Role B toward Role A is exactly

gi=kASi(VI,i−VS,i)−kBIi(VP,i−VI,i).\boxed{ g_i= k_A S_i(V_{I,i}-V_{S,i}) - k_B I_i(V_{P,i}-V_{I,i}). }gi​=kA​Si​(VI,i​−VS,i​)−kB​Ii​(VP,i​−VI,i​).​

This has a direct interpretation: a cell should favour the operation that generates the greatest additional probability of eventual useful output, accounting for the operation it would give up.

The underlying adjoint mathematics is established. The research proposal is to make these value probabilities into physical signalling fields, enabling the assembly to respond without a central optimiser.

2. Executed two-stage computational test

I built a fresh 12 × 12 reaction–diffusion model with two adjustable cellular roles, a substrate source along the left boundary and product collection along the right boundary. Roles could vary continuously between zero and one.

A gradient-based local controller was tested against uniform specialisation and numerical steady-state optimisation.

Collected functional output

  • Uniform roles: Collected output 0.2
  • Adapted roles: Collected output 0.3
  • Best tested offline: Collected output 0.3

Dimensionless model units; no experimental measurement

The autonomous-rule result uses ideal steady-state value sensing. The offline result is the best numerical optimum found, not a certified global optimum.

The controller improved collected output by 28.9%, while reducing the total fraction assigned to Role A from 72 to approximately 21 equivalent regions.

After moving the collection boundary from the right to the top, the old arrangement produced 0.2423. Reorganisation raised output to 0.3216, an improvement of approximately 32.7% over the frozen arrangement.

The field-sensitivity formulas were independently checked by finite-difference perturbations of the governing equations.

These are synthetic results. No cells have been engineered or measured, and the controller has not demonstrated real tissue morphogenesis.

3. The physical signalling obstruction

There is an important condition on the proposed architecture.

For diffusion-dominated transport, reverse-value signals can, in principle, be reproduced by additional positive reaction–diffusion fields. A source at the output region communicates value information backwards through the assembly.

For directed flow, the correct value fields require the transpose of the forward transport operator. That generally means sending information against the material flow.

I tested this by introducing rightward flow in the same two-role class of model.

Correct reverse-value controller

0.0832

The incorrect signalling transport lost about 70% of the improvement available above the uniform baseline.

This suggests a meaningful division of possible biological implementations: passive extracellular signals in diffusion-dominated environments versus active relays, contact-mediated signalling or external feedback in strongly directed environments.

Neither implementation has yet been experimentally established for this proposed controller.

4. New extension: organising the transport structure itself

Specialising cells is not sufficient when the connections between them limit material transport. I therefore introduced an adjustable permeability wijw_{ij}wij​ for each neighbouring pair of regions.

For a network transporting multiple molecular species, the exact sensitivity of useful output to changing an individual connection is

∂J∂wij=−∑αDα(xα,i−xα,j)(Vα,i−Vα,j).\boxed{ \frac{\partial J}{\partial w_{ij}} = -\sum_{\alpha} D_\alpha (x_{\alpha,i}-x_{\alpha,j}) (V_{\alpha,i}-V_{\alpha,j}). }∂wij​∂J​=−α∑​Dα​(xα,i​−xα,j​)(Vα,i​−Vα,j​).​

Here xαx_\alphaxα​ is the concentration of species α\alphaα, VαV_\alphaVα​ is its future-value field, and DαD_\alphaDα​ is its diffusion coefficient.

This is useful because the decision whether to strengthen a connection depends only on differences measurable at its two endpoints, assuming that the value fields are available.

I tested this in a second synthetic model containing 64 regions and 112 adjustable connections, with a fixed total permeability budget.

Functional benefit of adapting cell roles and transport connections

  • Initial structure: Collected output 0.1
  • Cell roles only: Collected output 0.2
  • Connections only: Collected output 0.2
  • Both together: Collected output 0.2

Joint adaptation increased output by approximately 84% relative to the original arrangement. The resulting network concentrated permeability into selected connections rather than distributing it uniformly.

Importantly, this is a mathematical permeability network, not a simulated vascular tissue. It excludes mechanical forces, cell migration, new vessel construction and maintenance costs.

Environmental reorganisation

I then moved the collection targets to a different boundary, keeping the initial substrate source unchanged.

The previously adapted network fell from 0.2228 to 0.1125 in output. Permitting both local specialisation and transport connectivity to readapt raised it to 0.3023.

An independent optimisation from a uniform starting configuration reached 0.3169. Thus the adaptive mechanism recovered much of the available function but did not find the best arrangement tested.

A separate controller that replaced exact global permeability projection with a single adjustable resource-price signal reached approximately 0.2254 in the original environment, with final permeability usage within 0.03% of the target budget. This suggests that a shared chemical resource signal could substitute for a central budget allocator in this model, although transient budget deviations remain.

The mathematical idea now connects three operations: selecting cellular roles, modifying transport links, and adapting both after a changed functional demand.

5. A candidate biochemical implementation

The important constructive step is that the reverse-value fields need not exist only in a computer.

For the two-stage system, consider three additional signalling species QP,QI,QSQ_P,Q_I,Q_SQP​,QI​,QS​, whose concentrations evolve according to

Q˙P=c−APTQP,Q˙I=kB(1−a)QP−AITQI,Q˙S=kAaQI−ASTQS.\begin{aligned} \dot Q_P &=c-A_P^TQ_P,\\ \dot Q_I &=k_B(1-a)Q_P-A_I^TQ_I,\\ \dot Q_S &=k_AaQ_I-A_S^TQ_S. \end{aligned}Q˙​P​Q˙​I​Q˙​S​​=c−APT​QP​,=kB​(1−a)QP​−AIT​QI​,=kA​aQI​−AST​QS​.​

Their equilibrium concentrations are precisely the mathematical value fields.

In principle, this gives a biochemical architecture where the output region produces QPQ_PQP​, Role B cells use incoming QPQ_PQP​ to generate QIQ_IQI​, and Role A cells similarly generate QSQ_SQS​. Each cell then uses its local substrate, intermediate and signalling concentrations to decide which role is more valuable.

The reactions can have nonnegative concentrations and rates in the linear cooperative model. The construction requires powered signal production, carefully matched transport and degradation, and molecular comparisons. It is not a passive reversal of the original chemistry.

Some relevant components have experimental precedent: engineered low-burden source–sink signalling in mammalian cells was reported in 2025, while a May 2026 preprint demonstrated contact-mediated signalling relays coupled to diffusible inhibition and multicellular patterning. Neither demonstrates the full reverse-value circuit.

ScienceDirect
+1

The unproved biological proposition is that a living assembly could perform the computation and actuation together, with no external reconstruction of its entire transport network.

6. Signal noise is a real resource constraint

I tested the two-stage controller with independent Poisson sampling noise in its value signals. Seven stochastic trials were run for each signal-count scale, with the same controller gain and iteration budget.

The scale multiplies the dimensionless signal concentration to obtain expected sampled counts; it is not a calibrated molecular abundance for a real organism.

At low signal counts, the controller still improves function, but much less effectively. An uncertainty-based deadband improved several low-count tests, although it did not demonstrate a decisive advantage over tuning the controller's response rate.

I also analysed an explicit stochastic chemical implementation in which signalling molecules generate downstream signalling species catalytically. In a smaller 4 × 4 network, exact stationary covariance calculations showed an interesting effect: the different signalling species are correlated, so the noise in their difference can be lower than an independent-Poisson approximation predicts. The reduction was roughly 5–10% for the tested local comparisons.

This is a useful refinement, not a claim that biological sensing is cheap. Temporal correlations, metabolic burden, signal crosstalk and experimentally attainable concentrations remain unresolved.

where DDD is diffusivity and μ\muμ is degradation rate. Consequently, a passive signalling mechanism can become prohibitively difficult to read across distances much greater than ℓ\ellℓ.

A scalable implementation may need active relay or hierarchical signalling, not merely more sensitive receptors.

The implication is that extending this approach to arbitrary nonlinear developmental programmes is a substantially harder problem than extending it to longer, cooperative chemical cascades.

8. Where the research stands against the strongest existing science

Several parts of this direction have clear incumbents:

The marginal-return optimisation principle for spatial enzyme allocation was developed in 2022 by Giunta and collaborators, who also discussed extensions to reaction cascades. 
Communications Physics

Vascular adaptation research has long recognised the need for locally generated signals to influence remote, upstream segments. The causal importance of reverse communication is not a new biological observation. 
American Physiological Society

Synthetic adhesion and signalling systems already produce multicellular structures, while 2026 work demonstrates programmable differentiation ratios and feedback-stabilised microbial populations. 
Science
+2

Externally controlled optogenetic systems already provide powerful closed-loop spatial actuation. They would be a serious comparator, especially where autonomous signalling is slow or inaccurate. 
Nature Communications

The candidate advance is therefore not the adjoint equation, feedback control, or self-organised patterning individually.

It is the proposed combination: a tissue-local implementation of function-specific reverse-value computation, coupled to reversible cell-role selection and structural transport adaptation.

That particular combination remains a research hypothesis. Priority and practical advantage have not been established.

The discriminating experiment

The clearest experimental route is a spatially structured, nonpathogenic synthetic consortium performing two extracellular conversion stages. A first implementation should test the signalling calculation itself before attempting full morphogenesis.

Independently measure the transport and degradation of each proposed value signal, and test whether its spatial concentration agrees with the required reverse-value equation.

Perturb one cell region's activity at a time, without refitting the model, and ask whether the locally measured value signals correctly predict the sign and magnitude of the change in useful output.

Permit reversible specialisation, change the collection location, and compare sustained output against a fixed-ratio system, an optimised static arrangement and an externally controlled system with the same resources.

Only then introduce programmable permeability or cell sorting, while measuring cell viability, maintenance requirements, signal production and net useful output.

One further simulation warning matters here. In the fully time-dependent model, moving the collection boundary could temporarily create an unusually large output reading from material already stored in the assembly. Such a transient did not represent an improvement in continuing production. Measurements must distinguish stored product release from a durable increase in conversion capability.

Research judgment

The strongest supported result is a mathematically exact relationship between local interventions and collective output for linear, transport-coupled biological operations. It now covers both changes in cellular roles and changes in transport connectivity. The calculations demonstrate useful adaptation and identify precise ways it can fail.

The strongest unresolved question is whether a living multicellular system can acquire and propagate those functional-value signals reliably and economically, especially when transport is directional, signals are noisy and regulatory interactions are nonlinear.

If that can be demonstrated, the framework could provide a route from programming biological shapes to programming assemblies that reorganise according to what they need to accomplish. If it cannot, the next constructive alternative is an actively relayed or hybrid biological–optical architecture.

The current work is a theoretical construction with executable numerical evidence—not a demonstrated biological invention or a civilisation-level breakthrough. Its main value is that the next experimental test has a clear causal prediction capable of distinguishing functional self-organisation from ordinary pattern formation.
